Package aor.proj3t.service.interfaces

Interface AuthorizationService

All Known Implementing Classes:
AuthorizationServiceImpl
public interface AuthorizationService
Service interface for role-based access control (RBAC) operations. This interface defines the contract for authorization services that enforce security policies and access controls throughout the application.

Key authorization services include:

  • Role-based Access: Enforcing permissions based on user roles (ADMIN, MANAGER, USER)
  • Resource Authorization: Validating access to specific resources and operations
  • Evaluation Access Control: Managing who can view, edit, or approve evaluations
  • Hierarchical Permissions: Supporting manager-subordinate access patterns
  • Centralized Security: Single point for authorization logic across the application

This service follows the Single Responsibility Principle by centralizing authorization logic separate from business logic, making it reusable across different application components.

  • Method Details

    • authorizeEvaluationAccess

      void authorizeEvaluationAccess(User requester, Long evaluatedId, Long evaluatorId)
      Authorizes access to evaluation data based on user roles and relationships. Enforces role-based access control for evaluation viewing and management operations.

      Access rules:

      • ADMIN: Can access all evaluations regardless of parameters
      • MANAGER: Can access evaluations where they are the evaluator or manage the evaluated user
      • USER: Can only access evaluations where they are the evaluated person
      Parameters:
      requester - the User entity making the authorization request
      evaluatedId - the ID of the user being evaluated (can be null for unrestricted access)
      evaluatorId - the ID of the evaluator (can be null for unrestricted access)
      Throws:
      ForbiddenException - if the requester lacks permission to access the specified evaluation data
